$comment: Supported Foundry-Edge pairing. docs/compatibility.md is the human-readable record; scripts/supported-pairing.mjs reads and validates this file, CI starts the gateway edge.image names, and scripts/supported-pairing.test.mjs fails when any other file pins a different Ferrum Edge image. edge.release is the Edge release the next Foundry release pairs with; the release workflow refuses a tag until it is filled and edge.image equals it. Values beginning with RELEASE-STEP are filled by the release step, never guessed.

foundry.version: RELEASE-STEP: the X.Y.Z that package.json and the vX.Y.Z tag will carry
foundry.source_commit: RELEASE-STEP: the commit vX.Y.Z points to (also the image's org.opencontainers.image.revision label)
foundry.image: RELEASE-STEP: ferrumedge/ferrum-foundry@sha256:<multi-arch index digest from the release run>
foundry.ci_evidence: RELEASE-STEP: URL of the green CI run for the tagged commit

edge.build: development build main-b96cfaadd41a676d39a409d47b48e0b0588fa86e (2026-08-27) from Ferrum Edge main, never a published release. It is the interim CI pin, not a supported pairing; edge.release names the Edge release Foundry will be paired with

release.version: RELEASE-STEP: the next published Ferrum Edge vX.Y.Z after v0.9.5 that meets every requirement below
release.source_commit: RELEASE-STEP: the commit that Edge release tag points to
release.image: RELEASE-STEP: ferrumedge/ferrum-edge@sha256:<multi-arch index digest Docker Hub publishes for that release>

platform_manifests.linux/amd64: RELEASE-STEP: sha256 of that release's linux/amd64 manifest
platform_manifests.linux/arm64: RELEASE-STEP: sha256 of that release's linux/arm64 manifest

requirements: It includes ferrum-edge#5661: a strong ETag on resource reads and If-Match on PUT/DELETE of proxies, upstreams, consumers, and plugin configs.

Its proxy-association and namespace-identity semantics agree with Foundry's walkthrough and critical journeys. Every Edge 0.9.x release, and Edge main, attaches the proxy association when a proxy-scoped plugin config is written (ferrum-edge#4611) and keys proxies, upstreams, plugin configs, and API specs on (namespace, id) (ferrum-edge 5db1d77a8); scripts/starter-journey.mjs and e2e/journeys/namespace-isolation.spec.ts still assert the behaviour of edge.image, which predates both. Whichever side moves, the gates must pass unchanged in intent against the release.

The full qualification is re-run with edge.image moved to that release, and every job is green on the pull request that moves it, before any Foundry release is published: Quality Gate, Pinned Gateway Contract (including capability parity, writable and read-only), Deployment Starter, Critical Journeys, and Container Gate.

rejected_images.finding: Not compatible with current Foundry. Deployment Starter failed the first-success walkthrough: a proxy-scoped key_auth config took effect before the walkthrough attached it (401, expected 200), because v0.9.5 attaches the association on write (ferrum-edge#4611). Critical Journeys failed 'a resource id cannot be reused in another namespace' (201, expected 409), because v0.9.5 keys resources on (namespace, id). It does not include ferrum-edge#5661. Quality Gate, Pinned Gateway Contract (including capability parity), and Container Gate passed.

gateway.admin_security: HS256 admin JWT with audience and FERRUM_ADMIN_REQUIRE_NAMESPACE_CLAIM=true

evidence: Pinned Gateway Contract (capability parity, read-only half)

tested.deployment: deploy/starter: Compose, nginx identity proxy with the shared group-to-role policy, production image

scale.real_gateway: demo seed and contract fixtures: tens of resources per namespace, two namespaces
scale.synthetic_request_budget: 500 and 50,000 records per collection (request counts and bytes only, src/api/dataLoadingBudget.test.ts)

best_effort: database mode on PostgreSQL or MySQL
other Chromium-based browsers, Firefox, and Safari
Kubernetes and other deployments that reproduce the documented trusted-proxy contract
not_qualified: file, dp, mesh, and node_agent gateway modes (modelled read-only in the UI, not run in CI)
any published Ferrum Edge release until edge.release is filled and qualified; v0.9.5 was evaluated and fails (edge.rejected_images)
any Ferrum Edge image other than edge.image
atomic concurrent-edit protection (needs ferrum-edge#5661 in a published release)
browser latency and more than one concurrent operator at scale

edge_dependencies.what: strong ETag on resource reads and If-Match on PUT/DELETE of proxies, upstreams, consumers, and plugin configs
edge_dependencies.status: merged on Ferrum Edge main as e55ce01893c25bd802cb4f10831c07ca32b3deda (2026-09-23); not in v0.9.5, any published image, or edge.image
edge_dependencies.effect_on_pinned_edge: Foundry's write guard verifies before every full-replacement write but sends it unconditionally, so a writer that commits within that round trip is not detected
